clone_field_equation.conditioning: complete sampled donor candidates, source identities, rescored fitness and selected revival donor; independent acceptance gates integrated analytically

experiment_contract.algorithm_object: Fixed-capacity phase-space empirical fields of the complete executed gas, with immutable donor history and actual conditional metric/noise
experiment_contract.exact_identity: Density and momentum increments equal explicit jump sources minus divergence of deposited flux. Fourier-field evolution composes clone, B/A, conditional O and boundary operators; centered clone gates and O innovations have their derived predictable covariance.
experiment_contract.execution_contract: Run through the shared Rust LectureSession; preserve full configuration, seed, trajectory evidence, observable normalization and required continuation checkpoints. No standalone supplied dynamics generates lecture observations.
experiment_contract.limitations: Clone predictions condition on sampled candidates, rescored fitness and revival source. O predictions condition on actual A1 state and configured factor. A/B reconstruction conditions on the recorded potential gradient. The recorded accounting identity does not test conditional predictions. Reduced fields retain the derived hidden-state memory.
experiment_contract.measurement: Spatial density, momentum, stress, energy or phase-space Fourier fields; analytic clone-gate and thermostat predictions; independent transport/kick reconstruction; complete mechanical sources.
experiment_contract.title: Algorithm-derived field equations and mechanical sources
experiment_contract.validation: Validate complete stage coverage/order and exact recorded sources; recorded stage telescoping checks accounting. Independently reconstruct copy and kick/transport maps with recorded potential gradients and recomputed viscosity. Independent actual-metric ensembles and exact polynomial quadrature test conditional means and all covariance components for Gaussian/uniform innovations.

notes: Stage budgets are computed from recorded eligibility and velocities; the source stage names identify any combined boundary operation.

The field accounting residual checks the sum of recorded increments. Independent copy and A/B residuals test the primitive maps; A/B reconstruction uses the recorded potential gradient and independently computes viscosity. Conditional mean and covariance predictions are tested by ensemble fluctuations. The weak field equation retains each realized clone, force, transport, boundary and eligibility source. Literal-copy gates are integrated conditional on actual candidates and rescored fitness, resolving immutable historical sources. The thermostat contribution is integrated under its actual innovation law; the plotted predictable scale belongs to its centered martingale and is not a confidence band for the full field increment.
